title: Hostile telepaths encountered on Mars

tellings.quote: If you go to Mars telepathically, the first thing you'll encounter is a group of five telepaths who are not exactly welcoming.

plain: If you travel to Mars with the mind, the first thing you meet is a group of five telepaths who are "not exactly welcoming." So says Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate in parapsychology, the study of psychic abilities, who passes it on without naming where it comes from. If true, it would mean minds of some kind dwell on Mars and can be reached by mental travel alone.
